messages:
incident-bot: CRIT_ALERT: Quality regression detector triggered for model rdx-13b-v2 in eu-west1. Signal: spike in low-confidence completions and user-reported hallucinations. Estimated affected requests: ~2.1% of tokentime-weighted traffic. Pager: @nina (oncall)

nina (oncall): seeing it, grabbing context. any recent rollouts?

jasper (ml-eng): I pushed rdx-13b-v2 as a canary 45m ago, full rollout at +30m. Canary metrics looked OK but we didn't catch tail-case prompts. Investigating eval set replays now.

paul (sre): telemetry shows increased lang_quality error-rate and increased retry volume to fallback. Latency normal. No infra regression.

kevin (prod): Customer reports trickling in: two enterprise customers reported incorrect legal advice from the model. Flagging P1 customer potential.

meera (support): I'm triaging the customer tickets, collecting transcripts. Will attach examples in a minute.

jasper (ml-eng): initial replay on the failing prompt set shows hallucinations for factual queries about legal statutes. Seems like a model weight regression in some attention head behavior after quantization change.

nina (oncall): we need immediate mitigation: options = 1) pin customers to previous model revision 2) rollback deploy 3) route traffic to smaller verified model. Preferences?

paul (sre): Recommend pin at infra level first for affected customers, then rollback global rollout. Pin is quickest (no deploy change).

jasper (ml-eng): Agree. I'm preparing the pin command and verification checks. Also preparing rollback artifact if needed.

devops-bot: Command queued: `rdx.pin --model rdx-13b-v1 --selector region=eu-west1 --duration 24h --reason "quality regression emergency"`

nina (oncall): @devops-bot execute now and confirm.

devops-bot: Executing...

devops-bot: Success: 100% of traffic in eu-west1 pinned to rdx-13b-v1. Propagation ETA 30s.

paul (sre): confirm: telemetry now shows routing to v1. Watching quality metrics.

jasper (ml-eng): starting quick A/B of v1 vs v2 on historical failing prompts locally to confirm improvement.

kevin (prod): Drafting customer notification for affected customers. Any objections to calling this an "unintended quality regression"? Need to be transparent but not alarming.

olivia (comms): suggest: "We detected a degradation in response quality from a recent model rollout affecting a small percentage of requests in eu-west1. We've pinned affected traffic to the previous model revision while we complete an investigation." Short, factual, and action-oriented.

meera (support): customer notification draft (for ticket):
> We’ve detected a temporary drop in response quality following a recent model update. Our on-call team has pinned affected traffic to a previous model revision to mitigate impact. We’re investigating root cause and will follow up with timelines.

kevin (prod): status-page draft (short):
> Incident: Model quality regression (rdx-13b-v2) — partial mitigation in place. We’ve pinned traffic in eu-west1 to rdx-13b-v1. Customers in affected regions may have received degraded responses. We continue to investigate.

olivia (comms): LGTM. Add expected next update time: +30m.

jaѕper (ml-eng): (analysis note) repro suggests quantization pass introduced distribution shift for tokens referencing legal entity names. Need to rollback quantization patch and re-run the compilation pipeline.

nina (oncall): Next steps checklist:
- Confirm pin mitigates customer errors (meera + support)
- Prepare rollback + CI checks (jasper + release)
- Notify status page + send customer tickets (kevin + olivia + meera)
- Prepare code/trace artifacts for postmortem (paul)

meera (support): Confirming ticket updates sent to affected customers with the draft. Two customers asked for immediate whitelisting back to v1 — done.

paul (sre): I've started collecting traces and model artifacts. Saved async dumps from v2 instances in s3://redwood-incidents/1965000000/ for the postmortem.

devops-bot: Rollback prepared: `rdx.rollback --model rdx-13b-v2 --to rdx-13b-v1 --region eu-west1 --dry-run`

jasper (ml-eng): Dry-run looks clean. If pin holds for 20m and metrics stable, we should do full rollback and cut a hotfix for quantization.

nina (oncall): let's wait 20m for stabilization then rollback. @olivia please publish status page update and set next update +20m.

olivia (comms): Status page update posted. Short link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1965000000. Next update scheduled in 20m.

kevin (prod): Customer comms bundle (for enterprise reps):
- Short summary of impact
- Mitigation actions taken (pin to v1)
- ETA for rollback & fix (TBD, will update)
- Contact path for urgent escalations

meera (support): forwarding bundle to reps now.

nina (oncall): 20m check: metrics show error-rate back to baseline, customer complaints stopped. Proceed with rollback?

jasper (ml-eng): Proceeding to trigger rollback. Command: `rdx.rollback --model rdx-13b-v2 --to rdx-13b-v1 --region eu-west1`

devops-bot: Executing rollback...

devops-bot: Rollback complete. New serving default for eu-west1: rdx-13b-v1.

paul (sre): Observability: quality and confidence metrics stable. No regression in latency.

nina (oncall): Closing immediate mitigation. Next: postmortem and action items. Assignments: jasper -> root cause & fix, paul -> deploy/rollback playbook updates, meera -> customer follow-ups, olivia -> customer-facing incident summary, kevin -> internal executive note.

olivia (comms): Draft for public post-incident message:
> We resolved a temporary degradation in response quality caused by a recent model compilation change. Affected traffic in eu-west1 was pinned to a previously validated model revision while the team reverted the rollout. No customer data was exposed. We are implementing additional testing in our compilation pipeline to prevent recurrence.

kevin (prod): exec note draft ready, flagged for review.

meera (support): sending final ticket updates now and marking impacted tickets as P1->resolved (pending customer confirmation).

jasper (ml-eng): action: revert quantization change in repo branch hotfix/quant-revert-1965000000, tests added for legal-entity prompt category. PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/2147

paul (sre): postmortem kickoff scheduled +3h. I've created runbook ticket to add a checklist for model-canary full-tail replay prior to rollout.

nina (oncall): thanks team. leaving a manual handoff note for next oncall in #eng-oncall. If any customer escalates, page me.

incident-bot: Incident closed for now: mitigation applied and rollback complete. Postmortem required.
